insights.title: Discount-Driven Revenue Erosion
insights.raw_finding: Correlation between sales and discount is 0.5976, while profit and discount correlation is -0.5765.
insights.business_insight: Promotional activities are successfully driving top-line volume, but at a significant cost to the bottom line. The 11.00% average discount rate is inversely related to profitability, suggesting that current discounting tiers are crossing the threshold of marginal utility and eroding the net profit margin to 8.14%.

insights.title: Critical Revenue and Profit Contraction
insights.raw_finding: Overall sales growth is -76.55% and profit growth is -52.65% over the analyzed period.
insights.business_insight: The business is facing a severe contraction. Although profit is declining less sharply than sales (slope of -6.49 vs -19.36), the 76.55% drop in revenue indicates a potential loss of market share or a failing product-market fit that requires immediate strategic pivot.

insights.title: Inefficient Revenue Scaling
insights.raw_finding: The correlation between sales and profit is -0.0594, with a max sales value of 1,910.00 vs a max profit of 179.50.
insights.business_insight: There is a near-zero correlation between transaction size and profitability, indicating that larger orders do not benefit from economies of scale. With an Average Order Value (AOV) of 641.50 but a Profit per Order of only 52.20, the business is likely over-investing in high-value, low-margin SKUs.

insights.title: Loss-Making Transaction Risk
insights.raw_finding: Profit range spans from -72.50 to 179.50, with a mean of 52.20.
insights.business_insight: The presence of significant negative outliers (min profit -72.50) suggests that certain transactions are being subsidized by the rest of the portfolio. Implementing a 'minimum margin' guardrail is essential, as the current 11.00% average discount is failing to prevent value-destructive sales.

insights.title: Category and Regional Concentration
insights.raw_finding: Technology represents 50% of order volume; West and North regions combined represent 60% of order volume.
insights.business_insight: The business has a high dependency on the Technology category and the West/North regions. While Technology drives volume, the overall 8.14% margin suggests that the portfolio needs diversification into higher-margin Office Supplies or Furniture segments to mitigate regional economic risks.
